title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Banana Mandarin 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: If you're looking for a flavour profile that challenges the norm and delights the senses, look no further than Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Banana Mandarin e-liquid. This is not your average fruit combo; it's a meticulous blend that takes two distinct flavours and turns them into something remarkable. Begin your vaping journey with the creamy, velvety texture of ripe bananas. This e-liquid captures the essence of freshly peeled bananas, complete with their natural sweetness and subtle complexities. The banana's comforting familiarity makes it an ideal starting point, creating a smooth and inviting base for what comes next. Enter mandarin. The citrus fruit bursts onto the scene with its characteristic zesty tang, offering a lively contrast to the banana's soft sweetness. The mandarin's vibrant notes dance with the banana, creating a harmonious yet unexpected flavour duo that you'll find hard to put down. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
